messages:
Noah Rivera: Handing GalenaPay (mid-market payments) to CS — closed today. Key asks: Private (VPC) deployment, Okta SSO, Dedicated capacity with monthly commit. Contacts: ava@galenapay.com (Product), samir@galenapay.com (Infra). Traffic estimate: 40 QPS peak, avg 180 tokens. Renewal in ~10 months. Legal requires DPA + SOC2 evidence. Immediate needs: CSM, eng ticket for VPC peering & cert exchange, compliance enablement. Risk: pilot delay >3w will reduce exec momentum.

Sofia Tran: I can take CSM. Can someone share ava's calendar and confirm pilot start window? I like to schedule kickoff in two weeks and draft the runbook.

Noah Rivera: Pilot target = 2 weeks. Ava = ava@galenapay.com, Samir (Okta admin) = samir@galenapay.com. Contract signed; legal loop started.

Ethan Wong: Eng notes: need CIDR ranges, outbound egress policy, Okta metadata (SP/IDP), and whether model pinning is required. If they pin a quantized model, allow 3-5d build. Creating infra ticket now and tagging Priya for support runbook inputs.

Priya Desai: Support will own runbook + post-prod ops. Need list of Galena SREs, log access method (S3 vs streaming), expected error modes, retention expectations. Propose a pilot tabletop incident at week 2.

OnboardBot: CHECKLIST CREATED - Kickoff requested (wk 1766600040), VPC peering form submitted, Okta metadata requested, Dedicated reservation pending, SOC2 artifact request logged. Link: https://internal.redwood/galenapay/onboarding

Sofia Tran: Recap owners / next steps:
- Sofia Tran: CSM, kickoff scheduling, onboarding runbook, weekly exec syncs (first 6 weeks)
- Ethan Wong: eng ticket (VPC peering, cert exchange, build estimate if pinned)
- Priya Desai: support runbook + pilot incident drill
- Noah Rivera: hand off SOC2 artifacts and legal notes
I like to schedule a 30m kickoff with their infra & compliance leads. :thumbsup:
